title: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: A Gateless Gruul-born young woman, insignificant by birth magic so few can notice her; she narrates and loses Hekara's sight again.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A shield mage from a desert world who can see Rat and shields the ritual from a God-Eternal.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and the true guildmaster of the Orzhov Syndicate.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker and Izzet guildmaster who shut down the Beacon and leads Operation Desperation.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and Golgari queen who accompanies the group to Rix Maadi to answer for Hekara's death.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: A Rakdos razorwitch and Rat's friend who died, is returned to the Cult, and revives as a blood witch who can no longer see Rat.

entities.name: Dame Exava
entities.description: A masked blood witch and Rakdos's current number two who refuses to let the Cult join and is attacked by Hekara.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon parun and guildmaster of the Cult of Rakdos, whose voice booms through Rix Maadi but who never appears.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: The Orzhov executive assistant to Kaya who delivers Hekara's corpse to the Cult.

entities.name: Whipsaw
entities.description: Hekara's favorite hellhound, calmed by Hekara.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker elf and expert on leylines who leads the ritual of Operation Desperation.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon Izzet parun, resurrected as the new Living Guildpact, who burns a God-Eternal then collapses.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The shapeshifting guildmaster of House Dimir who had been disguised as Chief Varryvort.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: The acting guildmaster of the Azorius Senate after Dovin Baan fled.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: The cyclops Gruul leader who attends the ritual.

entities.name: Ari Shokta
entities.description: Rat's mother, a Gruul warrior who regards Boruvo as a traitor.

entities.name: Gan Shokta
entities.description: Rat's father, a Gruul leader who can see her when he concentrates.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: Champion of the Selesnya Conclave who attends the ritual.

entities.name: Boruvo
entities.description: Rat's centaur godfather and a Selesnya spearmaster, formerly Gruul.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: The Prime Speaker of the Simic Combine.

entities.name: Vorel
entities.description: A Simic representative who accompanies Vannifar.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The angel guildmaster of the Boros Legion.

entities.name: Varryvort
entities.description: An Izzet goblin chief chemister who carries the Firemind's Vessel; Lazav was impersonating him.

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo
entities.description: A former Golgari guildmaster killed by a Rakdos blood witch in Rix Maadi.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who assigned the six missions and has lost the powers of the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The Orzhov leader Tomik Vrona once believed to be the true guildmaster.

entities.name: Bilagru
entities.description: A giant who rallied the Orzhov troops into battle.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker invading Ravnica.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Jace's team is sent to assassinate.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: The Azorius guildmaster who fled Ravnica.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped shut down the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Fayden

entities.description: A planeswalker who helped shut down the Planar Bridge.

entities.description: A demon planeswalker who helped shut down the Planar Bridge.

entities.description: A planeswalker helping rescue Ravnicans.

entities.description: A planeswalker helping rescue Ravnicans.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker on Jace's mission against Liliana.

entities.description: The guild ruled by Queen Vraska.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild led by Kaya.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of Ral Zarek and Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Azorius Senate

entities.description: The guild led by Lazav.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild led by Aurelia.

entities.name: Simic Combine

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild represented by Emmara Tandris.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The wild clans represented by Borborygmos.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's army of undead Eternals on Ravnica.

entities.name: God-Eternal
entities.description: A one-armed, bird-headed God-Eternal that attacks the ritual and is burned to nothing by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Operation Desperation
entities.description: The plan, needing all ten guilds, the leylines and Niv-Mizzet's bones, to resurrect Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Firemind's Vessel
entities.description: A brass model of a dragon head that holds Niv-Mizzet's spirit when summoned.

entities.name: Accumulator
entities.description: Ral Zarek's back-mounted device that stores and fires lightning.

entities.name: Living Guildpact
entities.description: The impartial arbiter power over the ten guilds that Jace lost and Niv-Mizzet is to take.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A device that Vraska senses has been shut down, freeing planeswalkers to leave.

entities.name: Beacon
entities.description: Bolas's summons shut down by Ral.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: The portal shut down by Fayden, Karn, Samut and Ob Nixilis; it disrupted the leylines.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane under attack by Bolas.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: The Rakdos volcanic guildhall below the Demon's Vestibule and Festival Grounds.

entities.name: Demon's Vestibule
entities.description: The five-hundred-step staircase lined with performers leading to Rix Maadi.

entities.name: Festival Grounds
entities.description: The courtyard at the foot of the Vestibule guarded by ogres.

entities.name: Jester's Crypt
entities.description: A shadow-shrouded aperture in Rix Maadi where Hekara's body is taken and she is resurrected.

entities.name: Embassy of the Guildpact
entities.description: The ruined site where the ritual takes place.

entities.name: Tenth District Plaza
entities.description: A Ravnican plaza where the portal used to stand.

events.summary: With the Golgari tunnels to Rix Maadi closed, the group surfaces and sees that the portal is gone from Tenth District Plaza, so the Planar Bridge has been shut down.
events.quote: Now, it was clear that Mister Fayden, Mister Karn, Miss Samut, and the Demon-Man Ob Nixilis had successfully shut down the Planar Bridge, as well.

events.summary: Vraska senses that the Immortal Sun has been shut down; the group chooses to stay and finish the work.
events.quote: It's down. The Immortal Sun has been shut down.

events.summary: Rat dreads entering Rix Maadi without Hekara.
events.quote: I dreaded going down there, into Rix Maadi.

events.summary: Kaya insists Vraska come without her Golgari defenders so she can explain Hekara's death to the Cult.
events.quote: If the Cultists wanted an explanation (or demanded vengeance) for the death of Emissary Hekara

events.summary: The party descends the Demon's Vestibule past Rakdos performers, whose puppeteer shows a Hekara marionette that throws razors at Zarek and Vraska.
events.quote: Seemingly of its own volition, the Hekara puppet threw very real razors at Zarek and Vraska.

events.summary: The party reaches the Festival Grounds and enters Rix Maadi, which is strangely empty.
events.quote: Queen Vraska muttered, "Screw it," and marched through the arched gothic doorway.

events.summary: Dame Exava appears in a burst of smoke and the guildmasters beg an audience with the Defiler.
events.quote: We honor you, Exava, as a blood witch of rare talent, and we beg an audience with your master, the Defiler.

events.summary: Rakdos's voice booms through the cavern demanding to know where his emissary is.
events.quote: WHERE IS OUR EMISSARY?

events.summary: Tomik Vrona arrives with an Orzhov thrull carrying Hekara's corpse and returns her to her people.
events.quote: I have brought Hekara back to her people.

events.summary: Exava and six blood witches dress Hekara's body in rags and bells and send it with the thrull into the Jester's Crypt, where the thrull is killed.
events.quote: Have your thrull take Hekara into the Jester's Crypt.

events.summary: Vrona reveals he serves Kaya as the true Orzhov guildmaster and that he sent the giant Bilagru to rally Orzhov troops.
events.quote: I am executive assistant to the true guildmaster of the Orzhov.

events.summary: Exava blames Hekara's death on the betrayal, denial and failure of Vraska, Zarek and Kaya.
events.quote: One of you betrayed her, one of you denied her, and one of you simply failed her.

events.summary: Rakdos refuses Niv-Mizzet's plan and Exava tells the group to leave.
events.quote: WE'LL HAVE NONE OF IT!

events.summary: Hekara emerges from the Jester's Crypt alive, resurrected as a blood witch.
events.quote: What's your hurry, partners?

events.summary: Vraska apologizes to Hekara for betraying her trust.
events.quote: I owe you an apology, Hekara. I never should have betrayed your trust.

events.summary: Hekara declares she will represent the Cult and fights Exava with razors, with Zarek shocking Exava from behind.
events.quote: Master Zarek fired up his Accumulator and fired off a relatively small bolt that caught Exava from behind.

events.summary: Hekara calms the hellhound Whipsaw and walks past Rat without noticing her, revealing that her resurrection has left her unable to see Rat.
events.quote: She walked right past me—without noticing me at all.

events.summary: Representatives gather at the ruins of the Embassy of the Guildpact; Rat explains Operation Desperation and the Firemind's Vessel placed on Niv-Mizzet's bones.
events.quote: Chief Varryvort gently placed the Vessel atop Master Niv-Mizzet's blackened bones.

events.summary: Nissa says she can repair the leylines now that the Bridge is gone.
events.quote: I believe I can repair them and help Ravnica reassert herself.

events.summary: Ari and Gan Shokta see Rat; Rat tells Boruvo, Ari, Gan and the Selesnya to get along.
events.quote: Both squinted at the space next to Teyo until they could see me.

events.summary: The guild representatives arrive; Lazav reveals he was disguised as Varryvort.
events.quote: Guildmaster Lazav of House Dimir reveal that he had been there all along

events.summary: Zarek reveals the plan is to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact, surprising several guild leaders.
events.quote: We are here to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact.

events.summary: Hekara admits she came without Rakdos's permission, and the leaders doubt the plan without him.
events.quote: The Boss didn't send me in his place. I totally came without his permission.

events.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
events.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

events.summary: Operation Desperation activates and Niv-Mizzet's bones ignite; the light draws a God-Eternal.
events.quote: it had attracted the attention of one of the God-Eternals

events.summary: Teyo shields all seventeen from the God-Eternal's fist until the ritual completes, then collapses.
events.quote: Teyo reached up with both hands and manifested a half sphere of light that covered all seventeen of us.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet is reborn with golden scales and a decagon seared into his chest.
events.quote: And then Master Niv-Mizzet was reborn, with scales of shiny gold

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet severs the God-Eternal's fist and burns it away with his breath.
events.quote: An unending torrent of flame engulfed the God-Eternal

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet crashes to the ground, barely moving, shattering the group's hopes.
events.quote: The dragon crashed down ten feet to the left of us, shaking the ground—and shattering all our hopes.

relations.note: Close friends; Hekara can no longer see Rat after her revival.
He is executive assistant to the true Orzhov guildmaster.
relations.quote: And so I have been about the business of serving my mistress.

relations.note: She is his current number two.
relations.quote: She's the Defiler's current number two.

relations.note: Exava tries to kill the revived Hekara.
relations.quote: Witch, I'll kill you all over again!
I am executive assistant to the true guildmaster of the Orzhov.
Once again, Queen Vraska stepped forward

relations.note: Acting guildmaster after Dovin Baan fled.
relations.quote: Mistress Lavinia was now acting guildmaster of the Azorius Senate.
Then Mistress Aurelia, guildmaster of the Boros Legion, flew in, still hot from battle.

relations.note: Prime Speaker of the Simic Combine.
relations.quote: Next came Prime Speaker Vannifar of the Simic Combine

relations.note: Ari regards him as a traitor for switching guilds.
relations.quote: particularly my mother, who regarded him as a traitor for having switched guilds

relations.note: Zarek consults her on the ritual.
relations.quote: So over there, Master Zarek's consulting with Miss Revane.
Chief Chemister Varryvort, an Izzet goblin
